description: This is a C# source file defining an analyzer class 'AliasClashAttributeAnalyzer' that uses Roslyn APIs to analyze code for alias clashes in interface and type definitions, particularly focusing on attribute-based alias annotations. It facilitates static analysis to detect conflicting aliases in Orleans framework constructs.

classes.name: AliasClashAttributeAnalyzer
classes.description: A Roslyn-based diagnostic analyzer for detecting alias clashes in Orleans interfaces and types.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up analysis context, registering actions to analyze compilation start, syntax nodes, and at compilation end for alias clashes.

methods.name: CollectTypeAliases
methods.description: Collects and records type alias attributes for various declarations.

methods.name: CheckMethodAliases
methods.description: Checks for duplicate method aliases within interface declarations and suggests renaming.

methods.name: ParsePrefixAndNumericSuffix
methods.description: Parses alias strings to separate prefix and numeric suffix for incremental alias generation.

methods.name: GetNumericSuffixLength
methods.description: Determines the length of numeric suffix in an alias string.
